questions.question: Moses told Israel that if they faithfully obeyed the LORD, where would God set them?
Moses told Israel that all peoples would see them called by the LORD's name. How would those peoples react?

answers.text: They would stand in awe of them
They would turn away from them
They would try to copy them

questions.question: Moses told Israel that if they obeyed, what would the LORD make them?

answers.text: The head and not the tail
The hands and not the feet
The eyes and not the ears

questions.question: Moses told Israel that if they kept the LORD's commandments and walked in His ways, what kind of people would He establish them as?
